headline: This looks like a fake bank call.

reasons.why: Asks for a code that can empty an account.
Real banks do not ask you to keep a secret.

what_to_do_now: Hang up or stop the chat.
Call your bank using the number on your card.
what_not_to_do: Do not share codes or passwords.
Do not call back a number from the message.
note: If you are unsure, contact them using a number you already know.
